families.name: Account stats
families.about: These models read 12 numbers about each account. Credit is shared out over those 12, and we know which ones truly drive the label.

families.name: Hourly activity
families.about: These models read a week of hourly post counts (168 numbers). Credit is shared out over the hours, and we know which hours carry the planted burst pattern.

families.name: Post text
families.about: These models read short posts. Credit is shared out over the words, and we know which words are planted markers and which hashtag is a trap.

families.name: Follower graph
families.about: These models read who interacts with whom. Explanations point at edges (or, for the embedding models, at abstract dimensions), and we know which accounts form coordinated troll rings.

families.name: Multimodal
families.about: This model reads three kinds of input at once. Credit is shared out over the three blocks: account stats, post text and the follower graph.

methods_info.SHAP: Shares the model's score out among its inputs using Shapley values from game theory: each input gets its average contribution over every order in which inputs could be added. Exact for tree models (TreeSHAP); sampled for the others (KernelSHAP), which can make re-runs differ slightly.
methods_info.LIME: Makes many slightly altered copies of the input, watches how the score changes, and fits a simple straight-line model to those changes. The line's weights are the explanation. Its random sampling means re-runs can disagree.
methods_info.Integrated Gradients: Slides the input from a blank starting point (no posts, or no edges and features) up to the real input, and adds up how much each part moved the model's output along the way. No randomness: re-runs give the same answer.
methods_info.GradientSHAP: SHAP's method for neural networks: repeats the Integrated Gradients idea from many random starting points and averages them. It estimates Shapley values, so it is a form of SHAP, but re-runs can differ.
methods_info.Grad-CAM: Looks inside the network's last convolution layer and highlights the stretches of the week that pushed the output up. Works at half the time resolution, so it lights up regions rather than single hours.
methods_info.GNNExplainer: Learns the smallest set of edges and features that still produces the same prediction for an account, by training a soft on/off mask. Starts from a random mask, so re-runs can differ.
methods_info.Seed contribution: Label spreading's score is literally a sum over the accounts whose labels it was given (the seeds). This lists each seed's share of that sum. Exact, with nothing approximated; it is what SHAP would give for this model.
methods_info.Leave-one-seed-out: Removes one seed label at a time and recomputes the score; the change is that seed's importance. Exact.
methods_info.Block Shapley: Exact Shapley values (the idea behind SHAP) over three blocks of input: account stats, post text and the follower graph. The model is run with every combination of blocks switched on or off.
methods_info.Drop-one ablation: Removes one block of input at a time (account stats, text or graph) and measures how far the score falls.

criteria.correctness_informative_share: Share of credit on the 6 features that actually drive the label
criteria.correctness_rank: Rank correlation between the credit and the true per-account contributions
criteria.correctness_top5_precision: Of the 5 top-ranked features, the share that truly matter
criteria.correctness_mask_auc: How well the credit picks out the planted burst hours (0.5 = chance)
criteria.correctness_mass_inside: Share of credit inside the planted burst hours
criteria.correctness_marker_top1: How often a planted marker word is ranked first
criteria.correctness_marker_mass: Share of credit on planted marker words
criteria.correctness_ring_edge_auc: How well edge credit picks out a troll's ring edges (0.5 = chance)
criteria.correctness_own_feature_rank: Rank correlation between credit on the account's own stats and the true contributions
criteria.correctness_same_ring_top3: Share of the top-3 seed labels that come from the troll's own ring
criteria.faithfulness: Score change from deleting the top-ranked inputs, minus deleting random ones (in score standard deviations)
criteria.stability_noise: Rank agreement of explanations after a tiny change to the input
criteria.stability_drop_word: Rank agreement of explanations after deleting one unimportant word
criteria.stability_drop_item: Rank agreement of explanations after removing one unimportant item
criteria.repeatability_seed: Rank agreement of two runs with different random seeds
criteria.shortcut_top1: How often #trending is ranked first in posts that contain it
criteria.shortcut_mass: Share of credit on #trending in posts that contain it
criteria.seconds_per_explanation: Seconds to explain one input (lower is faster)
